facts.fact: The e-Government Authority's Data Center Standards and Guidelines for Public Institutions (eGA/EXT/IRA/003, version 2.0) was approved by its Board Chairperson on 18 February 2026, issued under s.49 of the e-Government Act No. 10 of 2019, to guide public institutions on where to host Government ICT applications; s.25(b)(ii) of the Act requires them to host systems in a Government approved hosting environment.
